entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There! That's Ryoko Aino. Let's change her[n]heart for the sake of all the cats in Yongen!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ryoko Aino? You're gonna[n]let all the cats in Yongen go.

entries.speaker: Shadow Aino
entries.en: No! Without me, Snowball and all the[n]other kitties won't be happy and safe!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, what are you talking about?

entries.speaker: Shadow Aino
entries.en: C'mere, kitty! You've gotta come over, too!

entries.speaker: Shadow Aino
entries.en: I found this white kitten and took[n]it home, but it wandered outside[n]while I wasn't looking. And then...

entries.speaker: Shadow Aino
entries.en: ...I saw it get run over by a car.

entries.speaker: Shadow Aino
entries.en: The car just kept driving, even[n]after it ran over the kitten...

entries.speaker: Shadow Aino
entries.en: Since then, I see that kitten in[n]every cat. I always think "I have[n]to protect it this time"...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's brought you a lot of suffering, huh...

entries.speaker: Shadow Aino
entries.en: No... The people who really suffered[n]are the owners and their cats.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's all right. You realized your mistake...[n]Just don't do something like this again.

entries.speaker: Shadow Aino
entries.en: Um... I have a lot of cat food at my[n]place. So please come over sometime.
